pairs: Fecit quoque sibi domos in civitate David:
Also, he made houses for himself in the City of David.
And built a place for the ark of God,
and he set up a tent for it.
Illicitum est ut a quocumque portetur arca Dei nisi a Levitis,
“It is illicit for anyone to carry the ark of God except the Levites,
quos elegit Dominus ad portandum eam,
whom the Lord chose to carry it and to minister to himself,
et ad ministrandum sibi usque in æternum.
And he gathered all of Israel in Jerusalem,
ut afferretur arca Dei in locum suum,
so that the ark of God might be brought into its place,
which he had prepared for it.
there were both the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
and his brothers were one hundred twenty.
and his brothers were two hundred twenty.
and his brothers were one hundred thirty.
and his brothers were two hundred.
and his brothers were one hundred twelve.
Vos, qui estis principes familiarum Leviticarum,
“You who are the leaders of the Levitical families,
sanctificamini cum fratribus vestris, et afferte arcam Domini Dei Israël ad locum qui ei præparatus est:
be sanctified with your brothers, and bring the ark of the Lord God of Israel to the place that has been prepared for it.
when the Lord struck us because you were not present,
so also it might be now,
if we do what is illicit.”
Sanctificati sunt ergo sacerdotes et Levitæ ut portarent arcam Domini Dei Israël.
Therefore, the priests and the Levites were sanctified, so that they might carry the ark of the Lord God of Israel.
Et tulerunt filii Levi arcam Dei,
And the sons of Levi took the ark of God,
sicut præceperat Moyses juxta verbum Domini,
just as Moses had instructed, in accord with the word of the Lord,
upon their shoulders by the bars.
And David spoke to the leaders of the Levites,
ut constituerent de fratribus suis cantores in organis musicorum,
so that they might appoint, from their brothers, singers with musical instruments,
ut resonaret in excelsis sonitus lætitiæ.
so that a joyful noise might resound on high.
And they appointed from the Levites:
et de fratribus ejus Asaph filium Barachiæ:
and from his brothers, Asaph, the son of Berechiah;
Et cum eis fratres eorum: in secundo ordine,
And with them were their brothers in the second rank:
were sounding out with cymbals of brass.
et Banaias in nablis arcana cantabant.
and Benaiah were singing mysteries with the psalteries.
and Azaziah were singing a song of victory with the harps,
in citharis pro octava canebant epinicion.
Now Chenaniah, the leader of the Levites,
in order to mark out in advance the melodies.
For indeed, he was very skillful.
Et Barachias, et Elcana, janitores arcæ.
And Berechiah and Elkanah were porters of the ark.
were sounding the trumpets before the ark of God.
And Obededom and Jehiah were porters of the ark.
and all those greater by birth of Israel,
ierunt ad deportandam arcam fœderis Domini de domo Obededom cum lætitia.
went to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the house of Obededom with rejoicing.
Cumque adjuvisset Deus Levitas qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini,
And when God had assisted the Levites,
who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord,
they immolated seven bulls and seven rams.
Porro David erat indutus stola byssina,
Now David was clothed with a robe of fine linen,
et universi Levitæ qui portabant arcam,
as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark,
et Chonenias princeps prophetiæ inter cantores:
and Chenaniah, the leader of the prophecy among the singers.
David autem etiam indutus erat ephod lineo.
But David was also clothed with a linen ephod.
Universusque Israël deducebant arcam fœderis Domini in jubilo,
And all of Israel were leading back the ark of the covenant of the Lord with jubilation,
sounding out with the noise of horns,
Cumque pervenisset arca fœderis Domini usque ad civitatem David,
And when the ark of the covenant of the Lord had arrived in the City of David, Michal,
Michol filia Saul prospiciens per fenestram vidit regem David saltantem atque ludentem,
the daughter of Saul, gazing through a window, saw king David dancing and playing,
et despexit eum in corde suo.
and she despised him in her heart.
